verdicts.label: TRUE
verdicts.what_is_true_en: The image shows people celebrating India's Chandrayaan-3 mission successfully landing on the Moon on August 23, 2023. The image was published by BBC News in its coverage of the event.
verdicts.reasoning_en: Multiple reliable news sources confirm that widespread celebrations took place across India on August 23, 2023, to mark the successful landing of the Chandrayaan-3 spacecraft on the Moon (ws-4, ws-9, ws-6). Media provenance checks confirm the image in the post has a BBC News logo (mi-c1) and was used in a BBC news stream covering news from India (mp-1). While the same image was also used as a stock or illustrative photo in another BBC article about a different space-related topic (mp-3), its use in the general India news context and the widespread reporting of such celebrations on that date support the claim that the image depicts the Chandrayaan-3 celebrations.
